policy: Review every closed candidate set. Select only when ASV wording or an explicit mapped textual note distinguishes a reading; otherwise mark underdetermined and retain the base fallback. The base candidate is the SBLGNT reading.

decisions.evidence: ASV 'Mary' does not distinguish the Greek name forms Μαριὰμ and Μαρία; retain the base fallback.
ASV begins the verse 'And behold,' expressing the initial καὶ; this distinguishes the base reading from omission.
ASV says 'rolled away the stone' without 'from the door,' distinguishing the base reading from the added phrase.
ASV 'as lightning' permits both ὡς and ὡσεὶ and supplies no mapped textual note distinguishing them; retain the base fallback.
ASV 'as dead men' permits both ὡς and ὡσεὶ and supplies no mapped textual note distinguishing them; retain the base fallback.
ASV reads 'where the Lord lay,' explicitly expressing ὁ κύριος; the mapped textual-variant note identifies 'where he lay' as the alternative.
ASV 'they departed quickly from the tomb' expresses ἀπελθοῦσαι rather than the alternative 'went out' sense of ἐξελθοῦσαι.
ASV begins 'And behold, Jesus met them' and omits the added clause 'As they went to tell his disciples,' distinguishing the base reading.
ASV 'behold, Jesus' does not distinguish whether the Greek article ὁ precedes Jesus; the other note is not a mapped textual variant, so retain the base fallback.
ASV 'met them' permits both ὑπήντησεν and ἀπήντησεν; the other note is not a mapped textual variant, so retain the base fallback.

ASV 'come to the governor’s ears' does not conclusively distinguish ἐπὶ from ὑπὸ, and the mapped note is classed alternative_rendering and therefore cannot decide the reading; retain the base fallback.
ASV explicitly says 'we will persuade him,' expressing αὐτὸν and distinguishing the base reading from omission; the alternative-rendering note does not affect this unit.
ASV 'did as they were taught' does not distinguish the presence or omission of Greek τὰ; retain the base fallback.
ASV 'until this day' explicitly expresses ἡμέρας, distinguishing the base reading from omission.
ASV 'they worshipped him' explicitly expresses αὐτῷ, distinguishing the added-word reading; the other note is not a mapped textual variant.
ASV 'on earth' does not distinguish the presence or omission of the Greek article τῆς; retain the base fallback.
ASV 'Go ye therefore' explicitly expresses οὖν, distinguishing the base reading from omission.
ASV 'baptizing them' expresses the present participle βαπτίζοντες, distinguishing it from the aorist βαπτίσαντες.
ASV ends with 'the end of the world' and contains no 'Amen,' distinguishing the base reading from the added Ἀμήν; the supplied notes concern rendering, not this addition.
